name: UWE-4
health: Both counters reset 11 times in 45 days, with the last reset about 3.7 days before the end of the window, so the spacecraft may be rebooting. The uptime clock reset once, 3.6 days before the end. The two battery voltages look normal for single Li-ion cells, but their daily lows and highs drift down by roughly 55-95 mV per 30 days. That could be ageing or season effects, so I am not sure which. Panel temperatures look normal.

name: Geoscan
health: No reboots are evident: the clock has no resets and the 1-byte counter only wraps by design. Battery voltages look healthy, rising in sun and dipping in shadow, and the daily lows are rising (+47 to +98 mV per 30 days). That is more likely a season or sampling effect than ageing, and 22 days of data is too short to be sure. Panel temperatures swing by about 24 degC between sun and shadow, which is normal.
